features.name: Pulse
features.description: Activity feed with notes, social posts, and agent activity

features.name: Forum Channels
features.description: Forum-style threaded channels for long-form discussions

features.name: Agent-managed profiles
features.description: Let agents manage their own relay name and avatar instead of restoring the desktop copy

features.name: GitHub machine git
features.description: Clone, fetch, pull, and push github.com remotes (including private) with this computer's gh/git login. Buzz never puts your Nostr key in that git process.

features.name: Pocket Listen
features.description: Speak a thread, pause and resume, wait for a named Reader summary, and Follow along. Turn off to hide Listen controls.

features.name: Public GitHub reads
features.description: Show Overview, Files, and Fetch compare for public github.com remotes without cloning. Private clone still needs GitHub machine git.
